posts.author: Rasticore
posts.body:
Hi, I'm looking for a way to zoom in on the screen.
My characters and tiles appear very small, so I’d like a way to make them look larger.
I came across a script by Little Drago designed to do this, but unfortunately, it didn’t work. Later, I found a comment mentioning that the script isn’t compatible with the newer versions of RPG Maker XP. Does anyone have a script that can accomplish this?
Here’s the script’s page, in case anyone knows how to make it work:
https://littledrago.blogspot.com/2014/02/rgss-custom-resolution-map-zoom.html
Thanks in advance to anyone who can help! This is my first time posting here because most of my previous questions had already been answered in the forum.

posts.author: slimmmeiske2
posts.body: I've moved this thread to RGSS Script Requests. Thank you.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: I'm sorry to tell you this but that script has some curious issues like letting you open the main menu and return to a map that looks, well, normal. :S No zoom.
